question: Does Su et al. (2013) document a new Manila Bay fish sample, and does it add any species or precise locality beyond the 2009 lagoon heavy-metal paper?
citation: Su, G. L. S., Ramos, G. B., & Sia Su, M. L. L. (2013). Bioaccumulation and histopathological alteration of total lead in selected fishes from Manila Bay, Philippines. Saudi Journal of Biological Sciences, 20(4), 353–355. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.sjbs.2013.03.003.

sourceAccess.accessMethod: Reviewed the PubMed Central article text on 2026-11-20, including metadata, field methods, Table 1, study limitation, and references. The article text prints copyright © 2013 King Saud University and All rights reserved; no local file or article figure was retained.
sourceLocators: Bibliographic details and copyright: PMC record, lines 33–80; Saudi Journal of Biological Sciences 20(4), October 2013, pp. 353–355, DOI 10.1016/j.sjbs.2013.03.003.
Trawl route, FishBase identification, and five fish per species selected from the catch pool: Materials and Methods, printed p. 353; PMC lines 94–98.
Five fish taxa and Table 1: Results, printed pp. 353–354; PMC lines 99–113.
Article citation of the 2009 Su et al. paper: References, printed p. 355; PMC line 155.

sampleAsReported.studyPurpose: Assess total lead in fish muscle and histological changes; not a biodiversity inventory.
sampleAsReported.captureLocalityAsReported: Coastal lagoon of Manila Bay; no named lagoon subdivision or exact LPPCHEA assignment.
sampleAsReported.methodAsReported: A local fisherman caught fish with a trawl net. The described bottom-trawl route begins at the northern lagoon end, proceeds south, then returns north. Fish were identified using FishBase.
sampleAsReported.analyticalSubsampleAsReported: Five fish per species were randomly selected from the pool for lead analysis; the paper does not state total fish caught or a standardized catch count.
notReportedOrUnresolved: No collection date, year, or season is provided for the fish sample.
No fish-capture coordinates, named lagoon subdivision, municipality, station list, or LPPCHEA boundary crosswalk is given.
No sample vouchers, accession numbers, independent identification review, total catch count, or standardized effort is reported.
The article does not state whether the samples came from the 2007 pool reported by Su et al. (2009) or a distinct collection.

lineageAssessment.relationshipTo2009: The 2013 article cites Su et al. (2009) as prior research. Both papers describe a local fisherman’s bottom-trawl route from the northern coastal-lagoon end south and back, and both identify fish through FishBase. The 2013 paper lists five fish taxa, all present in the 2009 Table 2. However, the 2013 article supplies no collection dates and never says it reused the 2007 catch. Treat shared specimen-pool lineage as plausible but unconfirmed.
lineageAssessment.taxonomicDelta: No new fish name beyond the ten 2009 Table 2 entries; the five listed taxa are an overlapping subset.
lineageAssessment.geographicDelta: The 2013 source remains at the broad “coastal lagoon of Manila Bay” level and does not explicitly name Las Piñas–Parañaque Lagoon or LPPCHEA.

rightsAndEvidenceDecision.articleCopyrightAsPrinted: © 2013 King Saud University. Production and Hosting by Elsevier B.V. All rights reserved.
rightsAndEvidenceDecision.decision: Record this as an overlapping historical research lineage only. Do not count it as an independent occurrence source or add its five repeated taxa as new species records. Do not reproduce the article’s table, histology figure, concentrations, or safety interpretation.

nextActions: Keep the 2009 and 2013 papers linked but do not merge their sampling events until a dated field log, specimen record, or author statement resolves the fish-pool relationship.
Continue the wider NCR marine, brackish, freshwater, and wetland source sweep; Manila Bay studies do not close local waterbody or habitat coverage.
Do not use the 2013 historical lead measurements as current public food-safety advice or as a present-day water-quality claim.

sources.supports: Official PubMed Central full text provides the 2013 article citation, repeated trawl route, FishBase method, five listed fish taxa, five-per-species analytical subsample, broad locality, missing date, and all-rights-reserved statement.
PubMed bibliographic identity for the 2013 article and author list.
Article DOI and publisher identifier; publisher page could not be read in this review.

Author-uploaded 2009 comparison paper; its Table 2 list and methods show the overlapping taxa and similar trawl route. This comparison does not establish identical specimens.
